observations: App imports, saves, publishes, and launches in the NSW dylan developer environment.
Generated app exposes connector operation screens for GetCalculatorSchema, Health, ListCalculators, Calculate, GetEvidence, and ValidateInput.
The player displays a developer-environment banner.
Visual function is basic generated UI and not yet optimized for production use.
The Health click navigates to Health_Screen, but does not prove production service-boundary execution.

requiredImprovements: Replace generated connector UI with a purpose-built orchestration home screen.
Add explicit synthetic-data and non-production environment warnings.
Add loading, success, validation-error, and connector-error states.
Expose copyable correlation IDs for support.
Validate keyboard navigation and color contrast after redesign.
Configure production service-boundary endpoint and connection reference before claiming runtime calculation smoke.
